g.text: I think you left a fancy energy-blasting pistol thing here
Um, no. All my "fancy energy-blasting pistol things" are accounted for.
enh, I guess I'll just leave it
You seem upset. Is it something I said?
should I ask u about the weather?
I didn't love being called boring.
then I guess that's all for now!
Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
Depends on what the coolant towers are up to
I'd have to check. Either kind of cold or super cold. Either way, cold.
Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
It seems the jury's convinced by your defense
I was joking. I thought venus couldn't sustain life lol
and grants you a fresh start
Oh yeah. I guess you're in the time when Venus was inhospitable... Wild.
Ah right. In the future, the Orokin come along and invent coolant towers that cool Venus down.
Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
I'll do you one better. These days, people with robotic body upgrades maintain the towers, and I get along great with them.
Not at all. I go there all the time. We created planet-cooling technology ages ago. Lol.
cool! did we fix jupiter too?
There's only so much one can do with a gas giant, but there are stations in its atmosphere.
Well, what do you mean by "fix"? But not really.
darn. I guess I'll live with that midnight mind-trap forever.
I'd be happy to help free you of that mind-trap if I can.
Lettie told me if u fell into jupiter, u'd hit a point where the atmosphere is denser than ur body, so u'd bob up and down. stuck. forever falling then getting launched back up between densities
u know when ur mind settles into the quiet of the night and starts pulling all kinds of crazy things from your subconscious as u try to sleep? mind-traps!
Oh. Hah. Yeah, I know what you mean. You have one about Jupiter?
I have no idea what you're talking about.
that is until u disintegrate! plus it's the size of like 1300 earths... long fall... long launch!
Not that I'm judging. What's this Jupiter-related "mind-trap"?
You'd die quickly anyway. Just your body would be floating there, not "you" exactly.
I don't know if this helps, but size is relative. Earth actually seems pretty small when you live in space.
gosh no! It's not like that. It's just... wow this is embarrassing heh
and it always will be! but it helps to talk about it :')
not super comforting, but I appreciate the effort
it's not like I'm an astronaut anyway
jupiter would be a nightmare even if it were the size of earth tho
Hang on, I didn't mean to embarrass you. Sorry. Maybe I misunderstood.
^_^ it was just a roundabout way of saying I'm kinda scared of jupiter
oh duh! I guess u wouldn't have astronauts anymore
which I guess sounds silly to a future-person who hangs out in its atmosphere like all the time...
the word's kinda meaningless when EVERYONE's an astronaut lol
Not at all. Tell me more. :)
So an astronaut is someone who lives in space?
I still have no idea what you're talking about.
an astronaut is someone who *explores* space. people can't live there yet, but we visit!
That's pretty exciting. Humans are on the cusp of discovering so much, and you get to be right there to see it.
What's it like to be talking to a real live astronaut?
:) that's a really cool way to look at it
ummm... I've been enjoying our convo so much that I ignored the fancy energy-blasting pistol thing leaking some kinda green ooze onto the floor...
it's starting to smell weird sooo
I'm gonna get Quincy to deal with that
